title: Nonnegativity of the fourth moment
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function on the Boolean hypercube. Then its fourth moment under the uniform measure is nonnegative:
\[
  \E\!\left[f^4\right] \;=\; 2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n} f(x)^4 \;\ge\; 0.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a real-valued function on the n-dimensional Boolean hypercube
